name: security-cargo-build-script-trust-review
intent: Cargo build scripts/proc macros and build-time authority
artifacts: Cargo manifests/config, source replacement, build.rs/proc-macro dependencies and build environment privileges.
trace: Trace lower-trust dependency/source selection into code executed during build, separating ordinary data dependencies from executable build hooks.
experiment: Inspect inert owned fixtures or run only a reviewed local stub that writes a harmless marker under bounded permissions.
disproof: A dependency capable of build-time code execution is not an exploit when it is intentionally trusted and correctly sourced.
repair: Constrain sources and build authority, verify provenance and preserve legitimate build-script functionality.
branch_decisions: Build scripts and procedural macros execute on the build host even when the final target is a different architecture. Review registry/git/path source selection and lockfile revision with the build sandbox. A crate declaring a build script is not itself malicious; demonstrate an untrusted source gaining capabilities outside the declared build trust policy.
